scope: Partial hidden-state coverage: selected full tensors at external adapter boundaries in decoder layers [14, 15] of 28, 16-token prefill and eight decode calls; this does not establish acceptance of every intermediate tensor.
limits: The UART checker trusts the supplied manifest; archive_model_run.py separately checks source, NPZ packing, and embedded ELF bytes.
Integer matmul accumulators and all unlisted hidden tensors are outside this intermediate check.
Probe comparisons, synchronization, and diagnostic output affect instrumented execution time.
Attention/RoPE/SiLU are only observed through adjacent norm/linear boundaries
Int32 accumulators are not captured; int8 and scales checked at each linear consumer
Shared activation references are checked for equality before packing
Each selected adapter is called once, followed by AME resync and comparison; instrumentation changes timing and layout
